summary: Implementation plan for the Interactive Differential Equations 2D and 3D Laboratory (Laboratorio Interactivo de Ecuaciones Diferenciales 2D y 3D), featuring a modular mathematical engine, step-by-step analytical derivation with MathJax/KaTeX, dual Plotly/Three.js interactive 2D and 3D parameter surfaces, and Runge-Kutta 4 numerical verification.
